_doc: APP-REUSE-1 (owner, 2026-11-20): every GitHub App registered through the connect links, read from the tick Worker's credential_events ledger (D1 ultrastable-org, account 81e3). App ids and slugs are not secrets. Exactly one app per role is active; the rest are superseded and hold no stored key. The live registry is the credentials table; seed/worker/src/auth/routes.js reuseApp reads it before any connect link registers an app. Consumers: tests/foundation/test_connections.py, seed/worker/test/auth.test.js.
superseded_default: The four superseded apps hold no stored key (overwritten when the active apps registered), so the Worker cannot act as them: the app-audit step (seed/worker/src/appaudit.js, APP-INVENTORY-1) reads and prunes only the active apps, and records the live result as a credential_events row 'app-audit'. Removing a keyless app's installation or deleting the app itself is possible only from the owning account's GitHub settings and is an identity-bound step; the default in effect is that they stay installed and inert (a webhook from them fails signature verification).
live_check: credential_events event 'app-audit' (daily, tick step app-audit); test seed/worker/test/appaudit.test.js
